name: alibaba_arrivals
caption:
Source: Alibaba 2026 Spot GPU | n=466,867 jobs; 4,417 full hourly bins plus one partial bin.
Lower panel excludes first-hour n=3,740; zero bins retained. Arrivals do not measure idle GPU capacity.

name: alibaba_priority_counts
caption:
Source: Alibaba 2026 Spot GPU | n=466,867 job records; no missing priority labels.
Counts show submission volume, not occupied GPU capacity or computational work.

name: alibaba_duration_distribution
caption:
Source: Alibaba 2026 Spot GPU | n=466,867 jobs; all durations positive and present.
Empirical cumulative distributions retain the full duration range. Duration is source reported; censoring is not documented.

name: alibaba_hardware_demand
caption:
Source: Alibaba 2026 Spot GPU | n=466,867 jobs; two alternate interpretations, not additive.
Neither proxy is measured GPU use. Worker scope is ambiguous; anonymised GPU-series labels remain unresolved.

name: alibaba_resource_requests
caption:
Source: Alibaba 2026 Spot GPU | HP n=415,713; Spot n=51,154; all requests present.
Fractional GPU requests are retained as requests. Worker counts do not establish occupied GPU counts.
